shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright stone monolith
irregular rounded stone edge left unshaped
justification: Both are relief carvings on large irregular upright stone blocks with curvilinear, scroll-heavy motifs and a broadly anthropomorphic organisation, and both leave the lower/edge portions rough and uncarved. But A is a bold, sparse, deeply rounded frontal composition dominated by a large central disc and horizontal bands, whereas B is a dense, shallow, crowded field of small interlocking glyph-like and face-like elements arranged diagonally, so the compositional schemes and carving manner differ markedly.
